newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest BSE suspends Styl trading for day.
newsitem.headline: Budapest BSE suspends Styl trading for day.

text.p: The Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) said on Wednesday it has suspended trading in the shares of garment factory Styl Ruhagyar Rt for the whole day following reports by a daily newspaper about Styl's 1996 results and its plans for 1997.
The report was published in economic daily Napi Gazdasag.
"There's a possibility that market participants do not have equal access to the information," the bourse said in a statement.
The bourse also said the information was released a few days ahead of February 15 deadline by which bourse-listed companies have to publish their preliminary 1996 results.
On Tuesday Styl closed at 1,400 forints.
